svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print 6, all the same. Four sockets from the 84 mm core:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: post straight down (24.0 bore, hitch pin 60 mm from the centre);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rafter inward and up 21.8 degrees (30.1 bore);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two eave tube sockets along the ridge line (24.0 bore).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every bore 65 mm deep to a flat stop, 1.5 mm mouth chamfer, 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button hole 85 mm out in a 16 mm finger recess.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable bolt hole 10.5 mm through the centre, pointing inward and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 degrees down; flat spot face 39 mm out on that side, 27 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nut recess on the far side, its floor 22 mm from the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 30 mm washer, 14 x 10 mm spacer with the 6 mm ring on it,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 24 mm washer, M10 x 90 bolt; 20 mm washer and nyloc nut in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: recess. Snug plus a quarter turn: do not crush the print.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At the four corners the socket past the gable takes a cap.
